lessons.title: Straight & Level, Climbs & Descents
lessons.subtitle: Trim · speed changes · level-offs · glide
lessons.start_note: Starts in the air at about 2,500 ft, 3 nm south of Paya Lebar. MAVIS flies it first, then you fly level, trim, change speed, climb and descend to set heights, and glide. No landing.

lessons.title: Effects of Controls
lessons.subtitle: Pitch, roll, yaw, power · primary & secondary effects
lessons.start_note: Starts in the air at about 2,500 ft, 3 nm south of Paya Lebar. MAVIS flies it first, then you try the stick, pedals and throttle. No landing.

lessons.title: Slow Flight & Stalls
lessons.subtitle: Slow flight · stall recognition and recovery
lessons.start_note: Starts in the air at about 3,500 ft, 3 nm south of Paya Lebar. MAVIS flies the slow flight and talks you through the stall, then it's your turn. No landing.

lessons.title: Steep Turns
lessons.subtitle: 30° warm-up · 45° turns · height hold
lessons.start_note: Starts in the air at about 3,000 ft, 3 nm south of Paya Lebar. MAVIS flies the 30° turns and talks you through the 45° ones, then it's your turn. No landing.

lessons.title: Flight Familiarization
lessons.subtitle: Airborne start · get a feel for the aircraft
lessons.start_note: Starts in the air at about 2,500 ft, 3 nm south of Paya Lebar. Follow the to-do list, then point the nose at Paya Lebar. No landing.

lessons.title: Take-off
lessons.subtitle: Full power · rotate · climb out
lessons.start_note: Starts lined up on runway 02 at Paya Lebar. Take off and climb straight ahead to 1,000 ft, then you're put back on the runway.

lessons.title: Landing
lessons.subtitle: Final approach · flare · touchdown
lessons.start_note: Starts in the air on a 1.5 nm final for runway 02 at Paya Lebar. Fly the approach and land, rolling out to a stop.
